title: Javascript Expressions in JSX Practice
summary: Challenge to render two paragraphs, a credit line from a name constant and a copyright line with a dynamically computed current year, followed by the solution using new Date().getFullYear().

concepts.heading: Challenge requirements
points: Build a React app from scratch in a forked sandbox: two p elements.
First paragraph: Created by plus a name stored in a const. Second: copyright text with the current year, computed by JavaScript rather than hard-coded.
Mixes React rendering, JSX braces and plain JavaScript (Date API); looking up the Date method online is encouraged.

concepts.heading: Solution steps
points: Import React and ReactDOM, then call ReactDOM.render with a wrapper div (single root) holding both paragraphs, and document.getElementById('root') as the target.

Declare const name and a placeholder year const (e.g. 2019) to confirm braces work:

Created by {name}

.
To get the real year: create a Date object with new Date() (current date and time), then call its getFullYear() method, which returns the four-digit year as a number.
Logging the date object to the console helps confirm what it holds before extracting the year.
Use the result in JSX either through a const (const year = new Date().getFullYear()) or directly inline as {new Date().getFullYear()}, since the call evaluates to a value.

concepts.heading: Common mistake: missing parentheses
points: getFullYear without () is a reference to the function, not its result. React logs that functions are not valid as a React child, and nothing useful renders.
The parentheses call the method so the expression resolves to a number.

task.name: Dynamic copyright footer
task.starting_point: Practice sandbox with comments describing the steps and index.html containing div#root
task.goal: Display Created by <name> and Copyright <current year> where the year updates automatically
steps: Create const name with your name.
Obtain the current year using new Date().getFullYear() (look it up if needed).
Call ReactDOM.render with a div containing two paragraphs that use braces for name and year.
Render into the element returned by document.getElementById('root').
task.expected_result: Two paragraphs: Created by YOURNAME and Copyright with the current year (no hard-coded value).
task.reference_repo_path: Section 36 - React.js/36.08 Javascript Expressions in JSX Practice/js-experssions-in-jsx-practice

pitfalls: Rendering the two paragraphs without a wrapper element.
Hard-coding the year defeats the purpose of the exercise.
Reference repo diverges: it uses an h2/h3 and extra paragraphs, not the two p elements the lecture requested.
